prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original production VFX texture sheet for the dark fantasy dungeon game Grimhollow. A square canvas with FOUR equal horizontal rows stacked vertically, each a separate long horizontal magical beam cutout extending from left to right across roughly 90 percent of the canvas width. True transparent background. No frames, no text, no labels, no stars, no circles, no icons. The four rows must have generous transparent vertical gaps. Each row is a thin continuous ribbon with feathered edges, crisp painted filaments and clear transparent space above and below, with gently tapered ends. First row: jagged pale icy blue-white electrical arc, a fine bright zigzag core and delicate small branching sparks, a very narrow soft blue halo; thin and angular, not a chunky glowing bar. Second row: sinister crimson death ray, fine twisting white-red core threads surrounded by ragged translucent dark-red vapor. Third row: pale silver-gold light beam, elegant parallel twisting filaments and softly fading warm halo. Fourth row: green healing tether, delicate emerald filaments with faint warm highlights. All look hand-painted and smoothly antialiased with organic irregular contours; no pixel art and absolutely no solid rectangular bands. Each entire beam is fully visible in its own row. Texture-ready alpha cutouts for a renderer that stretches beams horizontally between two points. Keep main beams approximately 20 to 35 pixels thick relative to a 1024 pixel canvas, halo no more than 70 pixels, row centers at one eighth, three eighths, five eighths, seven eighths of height. No franchise assets.
